headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, with AI becoming a clear differentiator.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue increases YoY. TCS and HCLTech highlighted strong AI‑driven revenue, pushing operating margins above 20%. Several firms, including Infosys and Persistent, either delayed results or saw profit pressure. Guidance remains mixed, with Wipro introducing a modest outlook for Q3.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI sales contributed significantly to top‑line growth, especially for TCS and HCLTech.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed above 20% for the top performers, reflecting efficient cost control.

themes.title: Deal wins
themes.detail: Large US deals added $9.6 bn for TCS and $3.3 bn for HCLTech, supporting revenue momentum.

leaders.why: Highest revenue, 24% margin and AI revenue >10% of total.
Strong AI growth (78% YoY) and solid profit expansion.

laggards.why: Revenue grew but profit slipped, sentiment negative.
